name: Seikishi Sanranki
source:
Main character is a court magician who sneaks into a neighboring state territory looking for invasion foothold. He knows a medicine to deal with ordinary holy knights, but holy knight Vanessa is the main obstruction to his plan. He invents a scheme to lure her out and use her as body experiment object.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名宫廷魔法师，为寻找侵略据点而潜入邻国领土。他掌握着对付普通圣骑士的药物，但圣骑士瓦妮莎·诺瓦尔·里丰仍是计划的最大障碍。于是，他设计把瓦妮莎引出来，将她作为人体实验对象。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
